name: Suzanne La Tour

events.title: Godmother
events.description: 'Susanne de la tour' godmother, with Jean Coutant, to Susanne Garnier, daughter of Isaac Garnier and Elizabet Doublet

events.title: Godmother to grandson
events.description: 'Susanne la Moureux' godmother to Daniel, son of Daniel and Jeanne Lamoureux

bioAdditions: The French Church of New York register has a 'Susanne de la tour' as godmother in May 1700, the month André Lamoureux is first recorded in New York (S1). This is probably André's wife, using her maiden name in the French manner. In 1720 a 'Susanne la Moureux' was godmother to her grandson Daniel; the Davenport genealogy treats this as her last appearance (S1, S2).

sources.citation: Wittmeyer (ed.), Registers of the Église Françoise à la Nouvelle York (Huguenot Soc. Collections vol.1, 1886), pp.72 and 155
Giles, Thomas Davenport, Pioneer, and His Descendants, Section X p.355

researchLogEntry: Round 4: French Church register shows 'Susanne de la tour' as godmother in May 1700 (probable) and 'Susanne la Moureux' in 1720.
